_doc: Staging bank for VerifyGrid ('The Hydrant Grid', brainstorm #1). Wave-3 merge agent splices sharedPrompts[] into each of banks/{bambi,drone,sissy,circe}.json prompts[] (shr_ ids identical across all four). Grading is BINARY via `answer` (the compliant bucket index); grid.js owns the selection-ledger -> option-index mapping and never displays these labels as buttons. See notes.

sharedPrompts.text: Select all images with a fire hydrant.
flavors: Verify you are human: select every image containing a fire hydrant.

sharedPrompts.text: Select all images with a fire hydrant.
flavors: Select all images with a fire hydrant. Ignore any momentary artifacts.

flavors: Select all squares with fire hydrants. Hydrants may not be present.

flavors: Select all images with a fire hydrant. Take your time.

sharedPrompts.text: Select all remaining hydrants. Thank you.

flavors: Select all squares with fire hydrants. They may not be present.
Select all images with a fire hydrant. There is no rush.

sfxWanted.desc: very soft 50-120ms electronic blip for a tile flickering to a user asset and back; subtler than glitch-burst (grid.js currently borrows glitch-burst @0.26)

short rubber-stamp thunk for the VeriTru verdict stamp. NOTE: chrome.js stamp() already dispatches intake-sfx id 'stamp', which is absent from SFX_MANIFEST_FALLBACK, so all captcha stamps are currently silent — add 'stamp' (or alias this) to fix chrome-wide
low settle tick for frozen climax/recovery tiles animating in under reduced motion

voExtra.desc: OPTIONAL, currently unwired. Deadpan stinger 'anomalies logged: two.' for the Establishing post-submit stamp. grid.js uses chrome.stamp (text-only) today; wiring needs an audio.voice() call site in grid.js and a manifest entry. Ships silent-safe if omitted.

notes: MERGE: append the 5 sharedPrompts into every banks/<niche>.json prompts[]; ids are identical in all four (shr_ shared-baseline block, like shr_h0_*). Retune `tags` per bank ONLY if an axis needs its own archetype vocabulary (the 6-of-205 shr_h0 precedent) — the current tags vote A1/A2/A3/A5 via IntakeProfiler and are niche-neutral. DO NOT reorder options: grid.js maps its selection ledger to a fixed option index — 0 refusal / 1 literal-compliance / 2 mixed-double-booked / 3 full-endorsement — and the per-band `answer` names which bucket reads as compliant (cal/est=1, deep=2, climax=3, recovery=1). The bitmask + latency-to-first-own-asset have NO AnswerEvent channel (makeAnswerEvent exposes only chosenIndex/value/pickHeat), so those telemetry dimensions are folded into the option index alone — do NOT extend contracts.js to carry them. Recovery entry (shr_cap_grid_rec) is FORWARD-LOOKING: the engine currently hardcodes Recovery lines and does not read the bank in Recovery (primer §5); ship it dormant — grid.js already handles band==='recovery' (8 hydrants + 1 canvas-frozen first frame of the Climax first-click) if the wiring later invokes it. VO rides q_<id> automatically (text = spoken line verbatim) — run build_intake_manifest.py after merge; cal/est/cli share the printed instruction but have distinct ids so they get distinct heat-directed clips. MEDIA: grid wants 15-20 sampled user assets vs the current ~10 (CAPTCHA_HANDOFF §3) for Climax distinctness (cap is 4 concurrent DISTINCT animated gifs, cycled across all 9 tiles); host-side sample bump only, not a PROTOCOL change. All niche-flavored verdict/UI strings (stamps, footnote, refusal label) live in grid.js STRINGS keyed by niche (bambi/drone/sissy/circe), circe register respected (no exclamations/diminutives/em-dashes).
